en: A fantasy healer uses magic to resurrect a bird, which opens its eyes and raises a wing.
ja: 空想の治癒師が小鳥を生き返らせ、小鳥が手の中で目を開いて翼を上げている。
prompt:
Subject: resurrect, to bring back to life. Fantasy healer holds a small revived blue bird in BOTH cupped hands; bird opens its eyes and raises one wing. Depict magic using ONLY TWO small solid gold four-point stars with CLOSED DARK BROWN outlines. NO glow, NO aura, NO haze, NO light cloud, NO halos, NO smoke or mist, NO white strokes. Clean flat 2D sticker. No text.
Use attached invidious.png for drawing style only: thick rounded dark brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D forms. Exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands per person, normal compact forearm proportions. Clean smooth solid colors and restrained flat shadows. No watercolor grain, muddiness, speckles, mottling, paper texture, bleed or fuzzy edges. Transparent background, no detached ground shadows. All silhouettes clean closed dark brown outlines. 512x512 PNG RGBA.
